title: Tanker Rate Swings
summary: What caused the tanker rate spike and is it sustainable? VLCC rates on the benchmark TD3c (Ras Tanura - Ningbo) averaged around $16,500 per day during September. Rates for the week ending September 28, were $18,825/day.
